src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.7ea220c290f4e048:
An Audi A3 with a **1.5 TFSI engine producing 150 hp** and a DQ200 dual-clutch transmission arrived at our Russian car service in Belgrade for a major service. We replaced the timing belt.

Following diagnostic results, we also replaced the electric water pump. This component is separate from the timing belt service, and its replacement isn't connected to that. The diagnostics indicated that the pump had lost its efficiency and was no longer circulating the coolant properly, and we decided against waiting for it to impact the engine's temperature regulation. We filled the system with new antifreeze after completing the work.

In parallel, we performed a minor service as well, changing the engine oil and all necessary filters.

Next up was the transmission. The DQ200 is a dry-clutch robot, and we replaced the oil in the mechanical section as well as the working fluid in the mechatronics. Our recommendation for this transmission is straightforward: both the oil and mechatronics should be serviced at least once every **60,000 km**. Following this interval helps prolong the life of the unit and reduces the need for costly repairs.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.b7595d747f4d0a84:
Audi A3 sa benzinskim **1.5 TFSI od 150 KS** i robotizovanom transmisijom DQ200 stigao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu na veliki servis. Zamijenjen je zupčasti remen GRA. 

Na osnovu rezultata dijagnostike, zamijenili smo i električnu pumpu sistema hlađenja. To je poseban sklop, čija zamjena nije povezana sa velikim servisom i remenom GRA. Dijagnostika je pokazala da pumpa više ne ispunjava svoje funkcije i ne cirkuliše rashladnu tečnost kako treba, te nismo želeli da čekamo da to utiče na radnu temperaturu motora. Novi antifriz je dodan nakon radova. 

Paralelno smo uradili i manji servis: motorno ulje i sve potrebne filtre. 

Što se tiče transmisije, DQ200 je robot sa suvim spojkama. Zamijenjeno je ulje u mehaničkom dijelu i radna tečnost u mehatronici. Naša preporuka za ovu transmisiju je jednostavna: održavanje ulja i mehatronike ne ređe od jednom na **60 000 km**. Uz ovakav interval, agregat traje duže i ređe dolazi na skupi popravak.

src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.6b3c4cf7e151fefd: Kompleksno održavanje BMW 118d N47 nakon kupovine
src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.d501ec1810d7516f:
BMW 118d sa dizel motorom N47 i pređenih oko **380 000 km** stigao je u naš aut servis u Beogradu. Automobil je dopremljen iz Danske, a vlasnik ga je nedavno kupio i odlučio da započne sa kompletnim servisom kako bi se rešili uočeni problemi. Ovaj redosled radnji je nakon kupovine potpuno ispravan.

Započeli smo sa kompletnim malim servisom: motorno ulje i svi filteri – filter ulja, vazduha, kabinskog i goriva. Za N47, filter goriva je priča za sebe: stanje gorivne sisteme direktno utiče na rad motora i koliko će njegovi delovi trajati.

Nakon toga smo se posvetili ovjesu i kočnicama. Zamenili smo elastične manžetne, kočione diskove i pločice. Na polovnom vozilu sa velikim pređenim kilometrima, kočnice se proveravaju u prvom redu, a ovde su iznose bile toliko istrošene da je bilo neophodno da ih zamenimo kako bi vožnja bila bezbrižna.

Otkrili smo curenje na zadnjem reduktoru, zamenili smo semering i zaustavili gubitak maziva. Na vozilima sa ovakvim pređenim kilometrima, reduktor, zaptivke i ostatak transmisije zahtevaju posebnu pažnju.

Na 380 000 km, lista poslova se ne završava jednim posetom. Automobil ćemo postepeno dovoditi u red: potpuna dijagnostika, postavljanje prioriteta, a zatim redom motor, kočioni sistem, ovjes i transmisija. Upravo ovako savetujemo da se postupa nakon kupovine polovnog vozila.

Dizeli N47 su poznati našim majstorima. Uz redovno održavanje, ovakav pređeni kilometraža za motor nije konačan presudni faktor, ali odlaganje potrebnih popravki i propuštanje intervala ne dolazi u obzir ovde.
src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.f50d910ad7d74e74: Comprehensive Service for BMW 118d N47 After Purchase
src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.ff1c8f44b5cc7162:
A BMW 118d with a diesel N47 engine and a mileage of approximately **380,000 km** arrived at our car service in Belgrade. The vehicle was brought in from Denmark, recently purchased by its owner, who decided to start with a comprehensive service to address the issues that had already surfaced. This is the right approach after buying a used car.

We began with a complete minor service: changing the engine oil and all the filters — oil, air, cabin, and fuel. The fuel filter for the N47 is a separate story; the condition of the fuel system directly affects how smoothly the engine runs and how long its components will last.

Next, we moved on to the suspension and brakes. We replaced the elastic boots, brake discs, and pads. For a used vehicle with high mileage, the brakes are checked first, and in this case, the worn parts had to be replaced to ensure safe driving.

We identified a leak from the rear differential, replaced the seal, and stopped the loss of lubrication. For vehicles with this mileage, the differential, seals, and the rest of the transmission require special attention.

At 380,000 km, the list of necessary work cannot be completed in a single visit. We will gradually bring the car back to optimal condition: comprehensive diagnostics, setting priorities, and addressing the engine, brake system, suspension, and transmission in turn. This is the approach we recommend after purchasing a used vehicle.

Our technicians are familiar with the N47 diesels. With proper maintenance, such mileage is not a death knell for the engine, but it's crucial not to postpone repairs or skip service intervals.

src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.5f90e73d74efc830: Service of BMW X3 in Belgrade: Oil and Transmission Fluid Change
src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.6a01532c400abeb6:
Danas smo u našem autoservisu u Beogradu servisirali BMW X3. Ovo je već druga mala provera koju radimo na ovom vozilu.

Ovog puta je klijent tražio, pored uobičajene zamene ulja i filtera, i zamenu ulja u 8-stepenom automatskom menjaču **ZF**.

Kod ovog menjača menjamo ulje zajedno sa karterom: filter je ugrađen u karter, a produkti habanja i zagađenja se nakupljaju tamo. Zamena samo ulja ne predstavlja potpunu uslugu za ovaj automatski menjač.

U motor je stavljeno ulje sa odobrenjem **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04). Za BMW, odobrenje je ključno.

Takođe smo proverili i vortex klapne u usisu. Za sada nema kritičnih problema, ali smo klijentu rekli da ih na sledećoj maloj proverenoj provere treba skinuti i očistiti.
src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.6e2f86cf5ff33a4f: Servis BMW X3 u Beogradu: ulje i automatski menjač
src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.74b09b887a8cdf71:
Today at our car service in Belgrade, we serviced a BMW X3. This is the second minor service we've performed on this vehicle.

This time, the customer requested not only the usual oil and filter change but also the transmission fluid change for the 8-speed automatic transmission **ZF**.

For this transmission, we change the fluid along with the pan since the filter is integrated into the pan and wear particles along with contaminants accumulate there. Simply changing the fluid alone does not constitute a complete service for this automatic transmission.

We used oil that meets **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04) specifications. For BMW, having the correct specification is crucial.

We also checked the swirl flaps in the intake. There's nothing critical at the moment, but we advised the customer that during the next minor service, it would be good to remove and clean them.

src/content/works/honda-accord/index.md.a1391108ea7e3c0f: Honda Accord Maintenance in Belgrade: Oil and Filters
src/content/works/honda-accord/index.md.b46fb50999268ec8:
A Honda Accord with a gasoline engine came into our service center in Belgrade for scheduled maintenance.

We replaced the engine oil and key filters: air, oil, and cabin filters. New spark plugs were also installed, as they are crucial for the smooth operation of the gasoline engine, how it starts, and its fuel consumption.

Additionally, we replaced the coolant and brake fluid, as they are vital for the engine's operating temperature and the reliability of the brakes.

### How Often Should You Change Oil in a Honda Accord?

For the gasoline Accord, we recommend an interval of approximately **7,500 km**. Engine oil gradually loses its effectiveness, and at this interval, the engine receives fresh oil before the old oil can fail to perform properly.

In addition to oil changes, it’s wise to check the filters, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid, and other consumables during maintenance.
src/content/works/honda-accord/index.md.c5d9d9b73142ba2f:
Honda Accord sa benzinskim motorom došao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu na redovno tehničko održavanje.

Zamenili smo motorno ulje i osnovne filtre: vazdušni, uljni i filter kabine. Postavili smo nove svećice — od njih zavisi kako motor radi, kako se upali i koliko troši.

Dodatno smo zamenili antifriz i kočionu tečnost: od njih zavisi radna temperatura motora i pouzdanost kočnica.

### Koliko često menjati ulje u Honda Accord?

Za benzinski Accord preporučujemo interval od prilike **7 500 km**. Ulje postepeno gubi svoja svojstva, a na tom intervalu motor dobija sveže pre nego što staro prestane da radi kako treba.

Pored ulja, na održavanju je smisleno proveriti filtre, svećice, antifriz, kočionu tečnost i ostalu potrošnu robu.

src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.357820d0a07810b2:
Changing the oil in the **DSG DQ381** is a vital part of maintaining the transmission that should not be overlooked.

This time, we performed a scheduled oil change: the client chose **MEYLE** oil, we filled it up, and completed the necessary routine maintenance.

The DQ381 is a modern seven-speed DSG transmission with wet clutches, found in many Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda, and SEAT models. When serviced on time, this transmission can last a long time without significant issues.

The story is similar with other common DSG models, such as the DQ250 and DQ200. While their designs and specifications differ, the condition of the oil and timely maintenance directly influence the lifespan of the transmission, the function of the mechatronics, and the clutches.

We recommend focusing not only on the formal service schedule but also on real driving conditions. If the service history is unknown, driving a transmission on the same oil for 100,000 to 150,000 kilometers is definitely not advisable. At least every **100,000 km**, it’s wise to check when and how the transmission was serviced, and for DQ381 and DQ250, changing the oil usually makes sense significantly sooner.

Fresh, high-quality oil retains its properties under various temperatures and loads, providing lubrication and dissipating heat. By ensuring this, we can postpone costly repairs.

If you bought a used car and are unsure when the DSG DQ381, DQ250, or DQ200 was last serviced, be sure to check the condition of the transmission and its service history in advance.
src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.4726ad8f372e2d06: Zamena ulja u DSG DQ381 na Skoda Octavia
src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.4b7358940c460fa9: Oil Change for DSG DQ381 in Skoda Octavia
src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.c5c16114757647e6:
Zamena ulja u **DSG DQ381** predstavlja deo servisiranja menjača kojeg ne treba zanemariti.

Ovaj put smo izvršili planiranu zamenu: klijent je odabrao ulje **MEYLE**, sipali smo ga i obavili ostale potrebne radove.

DQ381 je savremeni sedmostepeni DSG menjač s mokrim kvačilima, koji se koristi u mnogim Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda i SEAT vozilima. Ukoliko se redovno servisira, ovakav menjač može dugo trajati bez ozbiljnih problema.

Kao i kod drugih popularnih DSG menjača, DQ250 i DQ200, situacija je slična. Iako se konstrukcija i propisi razlikuju, stanje ulja i pravovremeno održavanje direktno utiču na životni vek menjača, rad mehatronike i kvačila.

Preporučujemo da se ne oslanjate samo na formalne smernice, već i na stvarne uslove vožnje. Ukoliko nije poznata istorija servisa, vožnja na istom ulju kroz 100–150 hiljada kilometara definitivno nije preporučljiva. Svakih **100 000 km** ima smisla utvrditi kada i kako je obavljano održavanje menjača, a za DQ381 i DQ250, ulje obično treba menjati znatno ranije.

Sveže, kvalitetno ulje održava potrebne karakteristike pri različitim temperaturama i opterećenjima, podmazuje i odvodi toplotu. Na taj način se skupi popravak odlaže.

Kupili ste polovni automobil i ne znate kada je poslednji put servisiran DSG DQ381, DQ250 ili DQ200 — proverite stanje menjača i njegovu istoriju unapred.
